tools.name: get_financial_kpis
tools.description: Returns verified banking financial KPIs from AI_Finance SQL Server for one requested period. Use this tool for inflows, outflows, net cash flow, fees, refunds, transfers, transaction counts, active accounts, and average transaction amount. Keep currencies separate. date_to is inclusive.

date_from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive. Example: July 2026 ends on 2026-07-31.

metrics.description: Requested KPI names. Examples: total_inflows, total_outflows, net_cash_flow, fees, refunds, transfers, transactions, completed_transactions, pending_transactions, failed_transactions, reversed_transactions, active_accounts, average_transaction_amount.

tools.name: compare_financial_periods
tools.description: Compares one verified banking financial KPI between two periods. Use this tool when the user asks to compare periods, calculate change, variance, percentage change, increase, decrease, or month-over-month change. Results remain separated by currency.

date_from_1.description: Start date of period 1 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to_1.description: End date of period 1 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_from_2.description: Start date of period 2 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to_2.description: End date of period 2 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

metric.description: Financial KPI to compare. Examples: net_cash_flow, total_inflows, total_outflows, fees, refunds, transfers, transactions, active_accounts, average_transaction_amount.

tools.name: analyze_financial_trend
tools.description: Analyzes the monthly trend of one verified banking financial KPI across a requested date range. Use this tool for trend analysis, monthly movement, month-over-month behavior, or questions about how a KPI evolved over several months. Results remain separated by currency.

date_from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

metric.description: Financial KPI to trend. Examples: net_cash_flow, total_inflows, total_outflows, fees, refunds, transfers, transactions, active_accounts, average_transaction_amount.

tools.name: detect_financial_anomalies
tools.description: Detects unusual daily values of a verified banking financial KPI using a Modified Z-Score method. Use this tool for unusual values, abnormal movements, outliers, or anomalous days. Detection is performed separately by currency.

date_from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

metric.description: KPI to analyze for anomalies. Examples: net_cash_flow, total_outflows, total_inflows, fees, refunds, transfers, transactions, active_accounts, average_transaction_amount.

tools.name: analyze_cash_flow_drivers
tools.description: Analyzes the drivers of net cash-flow change between two periods using verified completed banking transactions. Shows period values, changes, and contribution percentages by transaction type. Use this tool when the user asks why net cash flow changed or what transaction types drove the change. Currency is analyzed separately.

date_from_1.description: Start date of period 1 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to_1.description: End date of period 1 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_from_2.description: Start date of period 2 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to_2.description: End date of period 2 in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

tools.name: forecast_financial_kpi
tools.description: Forecasts the next monthly value of a verified banking financial KPI using a trailing moving average of the latest completed months. Use this tool when the user asks for a forecast, projection, expected next month value, or future KPI. Forecasts must be clearly labeled as forecasts and remain separated by currency.

date_from.description: Start date of the historical period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

date_to.description: End date of the historical period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

metric.description: KPI to forecast. Examples: net_cash_flow, total_inflows, total_outflows, fees, refunds, transfers, transactions, active_accounts, average_transaction_amount.

lookback_months.description: Number of latest completed months used in the moving-average forecast. Default is 3.

tools.name: analyze_financial_ratios
tools.description: Calculate derived financial ratios for a specified currency and period using verified transaction data.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code such as USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY, or AUD.

date_to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, inclusive.
